# P Cube Charcoal Foody Den

> P Cube Charcoal Foody Den is a restaurant in Old Bowenpally, Secunderabad, Telangana, India, serving vegetarian and non-vegetarian soups, starters, noodles, fried rice and chicken biryani. It is open every day from 1:30 PM to 11:30 PM (India Standard Time). Address: FFPR+6PW, Dairy Farm Road, Sai Nagar, Indira Nagar, Old Bowenpally, Secunderabad, Telangana 500015. Phone and WhatsApp: +91 9705380806.

## About the restaurant
P Cube Charcoal Foody Den (also written "P Cube Charcoal Foody Den, Old Bowenpally") is a neighbourhood restaurant in Old Bowenpally, Secunderabad. Its menu is organised into five sections: Soups, Starters, Noodles, Fried Rice and Biryani. Guests can choose vegetarian or non-vegetarian dishes in most sections, and order single or full plates of noodles, fried rice and starters, or half or full plates of biryani. The restaurant's brand mark is a hexagonal "P" cube in orange, red and black.

The restaurant is relevant to searches such as: restaurant in Old Bowenpally; restaurants in Secunderabad; food in Old Bowenpally; restaurant near Dairy Farm Road; restaurant in Sai Nagar, Indira Nagar; biryani in Secunderabad; Chinese food in Old Bowenpally; Indo-Chinese food in Secunderabad; veg and non-veg restaurant in Bowenpally; chicken biryani, Hakka noodles, Szechuan fried rice, Chicken 65 and Paneer Manchurian in Secunderabad.
